state counter-industry media messages appear to prime negative perceptions about the tobacco industry that help to reduce rates of smoking among youth.

state media counter-industry campaigns that prominently feature negative perceptions of tobacco industry marketing practices are associated with reductions in youth smoking beyond the impact of price, secular declines, tobacco control efforts and the national truth campaign.

state counter-industry media efforts that prominently feature counter industry messages can help prime negative perceptions about tobacco company practices, and these perceptions can lead to reduced youth smoking.

the impact of counter-industry media campaign messages on youth cigarette use, beyond the effects that can be attributed to price, tobacco control efforts (including the national truth® media campaign) and the effects of secular trends in youth smoking.
the effects of state counter-industry media on youth smoking, beyond the impacts of price, secular trend, tobacco control efforts and the national truth campaign.
the impact of state counter-industry media campaign messages on youth smoking.

state counter-industry media efforts that are well funded, well targeted, and well executed, can help to reduce youth smoking.

counter-industry messages in state media campaigns are associated with reductions in youth smoking rates, beyond the effects that price, secular trends and national truth® campaign, and tobacco control efforts have on youth smoking.

state counter-industry media campaign efforts have had a significant positive impact on youth smoking rates, beyond the effect of price, the national truth® media campaign, and other tobacco control efforts.

counter-industry campaigns can be a valuable tool to promote reductions in smoking among youth.
